observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black PlayStation 4 console with a textured finish, placed on a white cloth with 'McSteve' branding.
The console has visible scratches and scuffs on the surface, especially on the right side.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 model, not the Pro version, based on the shape and lack of the 'Pro' label or distinct design features.
The background shows shelves with boxed electronics, including smartphones and accessories, suggesting a retail or resale environment.
No controller or other accessories are visible in either photo.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a screen.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a standard PS4 console, not a PS4 Pro. The 'Pro' label is not visible on the console in either photo.
No controller is visible in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controller may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the controller with the console, showing it is present and in working condition.

risks.risk: Console may have been tampered with or have hidden damage (e.g., disc drive, ports)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the disc drive, ports, and back panel to check for damage or wear.
